select p.id as id, title, image, is_vip, c.status as status, c.create_time as create_time from favorites f inner join collect c on f.id = c.favorites_id and c.status = 0 and f.id = #{favoritesId} and c.user_id = #{userId} inner join posts p on c.post_id = p.id and p.status = 2
and p.title like concat('%', #{postName}, '%')
order by c.create_time desc

select id, title, image, is_vip, b.create_time as create_time from posts inner join (select post_id, create_time from browse where user_id = #{userId} and type = #{type} and date(create_time) >= #{beginTime} and date(create_time) <= #{endTime} ) b on posts.id = b.post_id where status = 2 order by b.create_time desc
select id, post_id, tag_id, create_time from post_tag where post_id = #{postId}
select id, user_id, tag_id, weight, create_time, update_time from user_interest where user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from posts where author_id = #{userId} and post_type = #{type} and status = 2
select id, category_name, image from category where id = #{categoryId}
select id, content_type, content from posts_content where id = #{contentId}

SELECT p.id AS post_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE target_id = p.id AND type = 0 AND status = 0) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collect WHERE post_id = p.id AND status = 0) AS collect_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM browse WHERE post_id = p.id) AS browse_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = p.id AND type = 0 AND status = 0) AS comment_count FROM posts p WHERE p.id = #{postId}
select count(1) from likes where target_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId} and type = 0 and status = 0
select count(1) from collect where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0

select p.id as id, p.title as title, p.introduction as introduction, p.image as image, p.status as status, p.content_id as content_id, p.type as type, p.post_type as post_type, p.is_vip as is_vip, p.category_id as category_id, p.create_time as create_time, p.update_time as update_time, count(b.post_id) as browse_count from posts p left join browse b on p.id = b.post_id and b.type = 0 where p.type = 0 and p.post_type = #{postType} and p.status = 2 group by p.id order by count(b.post_id) desc limit 10

SELECT p.id AS id, p.title AS title, p.introduction AS introduction, p.image AS image, p.type AS type, p.post_type AS post_type, p.create_time AS create_time, p.update_time AS update_time, IFNULL(browse_count.browse_count, 0) AS browse_count, IFNULL(like_count.like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(collect_count.collect_count, 0) AS collect_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS browse_count FROM browse WHERE type = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) browse_count ON p.id = browse_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id AS post_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM likes WHERE type = 0 AND status = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) like_count ON p.id = like_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS collect_count FROM collect WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) collect_count ON p.id = collect_count.post_id LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON p.author_id = ui.user_id LEFT JOIN user_focus uf ON p.author_id = uf.focus_user_id AND uf.user_id = #{loginUserId} WHERE p.author_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 2 AND (p.type = 0 OR p.type = 2)
AND (p.type = 2 OR (p.type = 0 AND uf.focus_user_id IS NOT NULL))
AND ( p.create_time < #{lastCreateTime} OR (p.create_time = #{lastCreateTime} AND p.id < #{lastId}) )
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{size}
